item.title: Fesco eyes expansion with service from Cambodia to Russia
item.description: Russian shipping line Fesco yesterday launched a service between Cambodia and Russia as it tries to expand market share. Containers will be barged or feedered from Phnom Penh to Ho Chi Minh City, where Fesco has a transhipment facility.
